en:
I haven't seen the chief around, but I'm sure he'll be happy
to hear what went down.
Actually, he was over at the race. Let's just say the Three Musketeers had a happy reunion at last. And now it looks like they're going out for a drink.
Agh, I don't believe this!
What's not to believe? They all came together through racing, so I think they've resolved their differences.
That's not it at all! Why didn't they invite me out, too!?
That's what you're worried about!?
I spent my best years together with the Three Musketeers. I'm their d'Artagnan! How could they leave the main character out!?
Don't worry. They wanted to invite all the staff along too. They'll be here any minute now.
...Oh. Alrighty then.
Wow! I get to have drinks with the Three Musketeers!? This'll be a blast!
Hey, kiddo. Didn't you have something to tell Suzuki-san?
Oh yeah!
What is it, Kiyokawa?
Well, you see...
Come on, spit it out.
Suzuki-san, I...
I passed my Class 2 license test!
Yes! Muramatsu-san helped me get through the studying.
Kiyokawa was a nervous wreck, so I had to go to the test center with him. He's a handful, all right.
Thanks to him, I passed the written test on my first try! I can finally be a taxi driver now!
Just like you, I stepped up to the challenge... and made my own destiny!
Congratulations. Looks like all that work paid off.
Thanks for saying that. You helped me out so much!
Muramatsu-san is the one to thank. Don't forget your manners.
Thank you for the help, Muramatsu-san. I passed my test with flying colors...
So... do I get a present or something?
What!? That should be the other way around! You're supposed to get <Italic>me</Italic> a gift.
Oh, come on. Don't I deserve a reward?
...There's no hope for you, kid.

Attention, Nagasu Taxi members! I got one word for y'all...
<Italic>Drinkin'</Italic>! Who's up for it!?
I thought you'd never ask!
You're welcome to join, Hirakawa-san.

Oh, but I can get a bit crazy when I drink. What if I end up
shattering those glasses of yours?
...Uhm. What?
Heeeeey, it's time to paaaar-tay! Ahhh I'm so lucky to be here⑬ You guys are seriously the best! Hope you're ready to drink, Suzuki-san!
Heh, I am.
(Kiyokawa's right. There's something special about this company... and everyone who works here.)

Why ya spacin' out there, Suzuki-san!? They'll run outta
booze at this rate! C'mon, hop to it!
And they say you're Fukuoka's fastest. Let's get a move on!
(...I'm lucky to have them as friends.)
(I don't have any reason to go in. Besides, I'm broke.)
Welcome to the roulette table.
Welcome to the roulette table. Would you like to play one-on-one against the house?
Place your marker chips on the table.
Now the house will place its marker chips.
You first, sir. Please spin the ball.
Now it's the house's turn.
The house lost that one.
The house won that one.
Please come play again soon.
All player bets are in.
Here goes...
Allow me to explain the rules for roulette.
Betting starts as soon as the ball is spun. Place your bets before time expires. You can bet up to 1,000 chips with each spin.
Depending on where you place your chips, you can bet on one to six numbers, the colors red or black, or make a number of other wagers.
You can remove the chips you bet or move them to make another bet as long as time has not expired.
If you want to remove the chips you bet, press <Action:Button_R1@Roulette> at the location of your bet.
Select Last Bet to duplicate the last bet you made. Press <Action:Button_R1@Roulette> where no chips have been placed to bet chips of the same value as the last bet.
You only have a limited time to bet. Please place all your bets before time runs out.
When time runs out, "No More Bets" appears, indicating that betting is over. You can also end betting by pressing <Action:Button_Circle@Roulette>.
If the ball lands in a slot on which you bet, you win the payouts for all your wagers that include that slot. Otherwise, you lose your bet.
That is how you play roulette. Please enjoy playing all the games of skill and chance our casino has to offer!
The marker chips have been placed.
(They're cleaning now. Can't go in.)
(Tsuruhashi Fugetsu? Maybe Tatsuya will be interested in this place.)
(Kani Douraku, huh? I could tell Tatsuya about this place.)
(I'm going to Club SEGA with Park-san now.)
(Zuboraya, huh? I could tell Tatsuya about this place.)
(Kushikatsu Daruma? Maybe Tatsuya would be interested in this place.)
You cannot go beyond this point in the Demo.
(I'm supposed to be out shopping with Yui-chan. I wonder if she's finished with that yet. I should ask.)
(I don't need to be here right now.)

(The bartender isn't here. He said to meet him in
Shofukucho's parking lot.)
(I should just see what happens for now.)
(I've already been here. I should pick somewhere else.)
(Komian, huh? I could tell Tatsuya about this place.)
(Oof. This manhole cover is too heavy for me to lift.)
(I don't need anything here now.)
(I don't need to be here now.)
(Don't need nothin' here right now.)
(There's nothing here for me right now.)
(I'm not sure I want to go here alone...)
(Park-san wants me to go to Le Marche with her.)
(Where should I take the elevator?)
I can't go out dressed like this. I should get changed.
(Never mind.)
Akiyama-san, aren't we going to Park-san's office?
Whoops, right you are.
Akiyama-san, aren't we going up to the roof?
Oh, yeah. Let's go.

(The girl who last saw Park-san is supposed to be in the
lesson studio.)
...Yes?
Oh, I'll let you in right now.
(It's... kind of shady. I don't think I should go in.)
(It's a business of some sort. I should keep my ears open in town and get more information.)
(I should come here alone.)
(I'm a little too young for this place...)
Saejima, we passed the hunting hut.
Saejima, that's not the way to the hunting hut.

en: Ah, okay.
Saejima, we don't need to go deeper into the wild today.
Ah, true.
Saejima, the deer tracks don't go that way.
Hello! We meet again. It's me, Takeshita, the pitching genius. I'm back for another challenge!
Oh, right. You throw ten pitches, right? If I get even one hit off you...
You win a spectacular reward! But I'm going to shut you down again anyway.
Uhhh, excuse me! You, there! Yes, you!
Hot diggity dog, it <Italic>is</Italic> you! Boy, I've been looking all over for you!
And you are...? Oh wait, do I owe you money? Sorry, but I'm all tapped out at the moment.
Pardon? What's all this about money? I don't recall lending you anything.
Oh, for real? Then who are you?
My name's Takeshita. I've seen you bat here before, and lemme tell ya, you're a monster in disguise!
Oh, uh. Thank you?
I've been pitching since I was a kid, see. I got a pretty mean throw, if I do say so myself. So I'm wondering if I can challenge you.
Challenge me as in, "Try to hit my pitches"?
Yup, that's it! These pitching machines got nothing on me, so you'd better not underestimate me!
That's nice. But I'll pass.
Well, what's in it for me?
Well, I can throw better than any machine, and I'll even do it for free. I can throw a hundred pitches your way!
Nope. Don't have that kind of time.
Well, how about fifty?
Not feeling it.
Ten! How about ten? I'm sure you can do ten pitches.
I said no!
Why on earth would you be coming to the batting center, then?
For gift certifi⑬ Look, it's none of your business, okay!?
Oh, I see! You're a bounty hunter batter! Very well. If you can get a hit off me, I'll give you a reward.
A reward? Like what?
Uh, well... It will be something spectacular, I can assure you.
Please! If you can get one hit off me in ten pitches, you win. That's all you need to do. Okay?
All right. You better make good on that prize, though.
That's what I wanted to hear!
I don't get it. How did you do that so easily? It's like you read my every move... Agh, I'm a terrible pitcher!
(His pitching's really not that great, but he doesn't have to get so down on himself...)
Uh, well, I thought your pitching was stellar. Maybe I just got lucky.
Oh, yeah. Like you said, these pitching machines got nothing on you.
Awesome! I knew it, my pitching is special. Welp, bye and thank you!
Hey, not so fast! Where's my spectacular reward?
Oh. Um... How's this?
What about this is spectacular!?
Okay, I have to go! Please let me challenge you again!
(...Hell no.)
Ka-shunk!
What's the big idea, taking my picture like that?
Wicked mystery batter appears at the batting center! Challengers wanted! Share if you like this content!
Hey, are you listening?
Oops, sorry! Didn't mean to ignore. I'm Kotetsu, the blogger.
You blog on that flip phone?
Sure do. I blog about basically anything baseball. Got me some mad page views, my boy!
Okay. So what makes a blogger take a photo of me? Unwarranted, might I add.
Because your batting is supernatural, man! I wanted everyone to know, so naturally I snapped a sick still life and posted you up online.
Wait, my face is on the internet now!? You gotta be kidding me! Not cool, man!
What, I don't see any problem. It's not costing you anything. I might even compensate you someday.
Look, you can't just⑬
Incidentally, lots of big baseball people read my blog. You may be getting challenges from some of them.
Aww, come on. That just sounds like a pain in the ass.
Goodness, would you look at the time? Gotta run! See you at the cages again!
(What is with that guy? I got a bad feeling about this...)
There! I did it. I knew I'm the greatest!
Oh, but you are a wicked batter. The way you stand in the box⑬it was really intimidating!
Let's have a rematch sometime, so you can get that spectacular reward! Bye!
(Oh, boy. I have to see this guy again? I am curious about that spectacular reward, though.)
Excuse me. Are you the amazing batter everyone's been talking about?
(Mamma mia! She's beautiful!)
Ah. Why yes, I do understand there have been some positive rumors about me. And you are?
I'm Yukina Aota. I've been looking all over for you.
You see, my daddy... he needs help. I thought you'd be the right guy to ask.
Umm... Okay?
See, my daddy works at a bank, and he coaches his branch's baseball team.
If they don't win the game they're playing right now, he says he's gonna get fired!
How's that possible? They're only playing for fun, right? Why would he get fired over that?
Daddy's boss is the branch manager. He loves baseball, especially their annual tournament. A winning coach even gets a foot up on promotions.
I see. So your daddy volunteered to be a coach 'cause he had an eye on that promotion?
That's exactly what he did, even though he doesn't know a thing about baseball. The team hasn't won a single game since he became coach.

The branch manager is furious, too... If the team doesn't
win this one, they'll come in last, and Daddy will lose his
job!
So please, I beg of you! Won't you join his team and help them win? If Daddy were to lose his job, I... don't know what I'd do!
(A little bombshell like this <Italic>and</Italic> a banker dad? Yowza! Hope she's single.)
Worry not, fair maiden. Tears have no place on the cheeks of a goddess.
...I'm sorry, what?
Have no fear, Yukina-chan. I would be honored to lend my assistance to your father's ailing team. You have my word, I will lead them to victory!
You will? Yay, you're my hero!
Now let us be off! To the games, at once!
Um, excuse me? May we have a word with you?
Yes? You do mean me, right?
We do if you're the guy from Kotetsu-san's blog. We need an ace in the hole, and fast!
Our team is in dire straits, you see. We're wondering if we can get your help.
Wait, come again? Who are you guys anyway?
Oh, we're from a local sandlot team.
We've always had no problem playing at the public park, but about a year ago, some hooligans showed up and started kicking us out.
Yes. We make proper bookings through city hall, but they just strut around punching and kicking until we give up the field.
Dang... That sucks. Did you take it up with city hall?
We thought of that. But that won't make up for all our pain and humiliation.
So we decided to settle this ourselves. We challenged their gang to a game.
We made them promise to never hijack the grounds from us if we beat them.
That's an interesting solution. So, when's that game going down?
The thing is... It's on right now.
Whoa! That was fast.
